lessons.trigger_condition: The tablet startup manifest covered the backend and most browser assets but some operational control-plane paths such as main, recovery, boot, live verification, Drive install/sync and collection launchers were outside the single fail-closed runtime list, allowing coverage drift between startup, QA and CI.
lessons.prevention_rule: Treat update, recovery, scheduled update, boot launcher, final/live verification, runtime probe/QA, Drive sync/install, collection launcher, PWA entry assets and autonomy/card runtime as one deployable tablet unit. START must fail closed when any required member is missing, V400 tablet_ops must score the same manifest, main must expose a full tablet audit, and protected tablet checks must cover control-plane changes.
validation_required: sync-watched changes are exactly VERIFY_TABLET_FINAL.sh, main, tablet_autonomous_evolution_v400.py and tablet_runtime_manifest.py
tablet_runtime_manifest exposes TABLET_CONTROL_PLANE_FILES and TABLET_PWA_ENTRY_FILES and includes both in ACTIVE_RUNTIME_FILES
START_TCG_UPDATER_ANDROID.sh continues to execute tablet_runtime_manifest.py --check --compile before server start
V400 tablet_ops reads the manifest and scores control-plane, PWA and full-runtime coverage
main tablet-audit executes manifest compile audit, shared runtime QA and V400 self-test
Final Tablet Guard and Android Updater Guard cover expanded tablet control-plane paths
source code auto-generation/rewrite, arbitrary command execution, runtime Git/main writes and verification bypass remain forbidden
price, grade, stock, release, event and market-direction invention remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching device evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V397 expands deployment completeness and verification coverage only. It does not grant runtime source editing, command synthesis, Git mutation, fact promotion, or physical-device success claims.
